text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Zephyr. Hey there~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Zephyr-san. Are you heading off to 
lunch?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hello. Yes, I'm feeling a nice, warm sun 
today, so—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of having it somewhere 
close to the sun, if possible. Though I 
haven't quite decided on the spot yet—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Renga-hane-san's voice... Fufu, let's head 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave. May the 
wind of hospitality bless you both.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...There she goes. Man, she really just 
marches to the beat of her own drum.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you brought a bento today too. 
Maybe it's a good thing I didn't ask, 
"Wanna hit the cafeteria together 
sometime?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're not a cold person, so I feel 
like if you had spoken up, they would've 
taken it into consideration, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
She truly is like a free wind, bound by 
neither her surroundings, nor anyone, nor 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's true. ...Ah, but wait.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I was just thinking earlier, 'maybe 
I should invite them out for once,' you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like her vibe has changed 
a little bit lately compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, rather than having changed... it 
feels more like she's 'in the middle of 
changing'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If I recall correctly, that happened back 
when I had just started training Yamanin 
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training was halted due to a sudden 
downpour, and I was idly watching TV in 
the trainer's office to pass the time, 
but...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, onto our next segment: Rising 
Star Discovery!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"We're introducing all the notable 
Umamusume debuting this year at once! 
Perhaps the next hero will be born right 
here? You won't want to miss this!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san. Just now, the south 
wind outside shifted from dark to bright.
choice_data_list: Um... looks like the rain stopped?
Um... looks like the rain has stopped?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Looks like I can run. Let's resume 
our training.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"First, hopes are high for her to make 
waves in the mile division with her 
signature powerful running—"
choice_data_list:
...Are you sure you don't want to watch 
the rest?

...Are you sure you don't want to watch 
the rest?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ? Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though there might be strong rivals 
in this bunch worth keeping an eye on? I 
almost asked that, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...In the race, I shall become the true 
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of lightning-swift 
typhoon is swirling around her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The strongest, the fastest, I will blow 
past all of it and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had felt it during her debut race—no, 
ever since we first met—Yamanin Zephyr's 
easygoing, at-her-own-pace nature was 
truly on another level.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Never wavering. Never bound. Never 
influenced. Truly, like the free wind 
itself—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Or so it was supposed to be, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I called out to her several 
times, but there was no response at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She, who was meant to be the formless 
wind, was caught in a firm grasp and held 
tight. Reflected on the screen was her 
destined partner.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio has taken the lead! 
She charges up the final slope toward the 
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Tokai Teio, showing off 
that legendary burst of speed! —Tokai Teio 
crosses the line first!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Tokai Teio! It's Tokai Teio! 
She is truly the "Undefeated Emperor"!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, that was a digest look at 
the other day's race!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Tokai Teio. Congratulations on 
your four-race winning streak since debut!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nishishi~ Thanks a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With this, just as declared earlier, she 
heads into the Satsuki Sho—the first leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown—completely 
undefeated!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Please, tell us about your determination.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll win! I'm not stopping to 
celebrate four consecutive wins with a 
'Hooray!'. This is where it really begins!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the Satsuki Sho, the Japan Derby, 
and the Kikuka Sho to become an 
'undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume'!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, as expected...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keeping her gaze fixed on Tokai Teio, who 
smiles with utter confidence, Yamanin 
Zephyr quietly mutters under her breath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had shown a certain obsession 
specifically toward Tokai Teio from way 
back, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day I heard they had a 
long, deep talk together, the vector of 
those feelings seemed to grow stronger and 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
("Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume"... 
That was the very title earned by "The 
Emperor.")

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, Teio-san, you too are 
chasing after the wind of your 
admiration—)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"So after all, it seems you need only 
steadily walk the path to becoming the 
'Emperor' of the new generation...!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Hm? ...Ah, well, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I think that's a bit off!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez is my idol. That's why I want to be 
an Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume, just 
like her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That's not my finish line, though! —My 
dream lies much, much further ahead."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm gonna become an 'Empress' 
who surpasses the 'Emperor.'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll definitely surpass that 
great back I look up to! I'm going to 
become the strongest, invincible Emperor!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...—Surpass.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Surpassing the one I look up to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...A sudden gust of wind blows in through 
the wide-open window. Carried along with 
it were cherry blossom petals."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Zealand Trophy is right around the 
corner. —A turbulent spring is 
approaching.
